description: React component that displays file details, content, and provides actions such as read, write, rename, move, copy, and delete for files or directories in a file system UI.

methods.name: FileDetails({ selectedPath, selectedMeta, onRefreshTree })
methods.description: React functional component that renders a file detail view, supporting read, write, rename, move, copy, and delete operations.

methods.name: fetchContent()
methods.description: Fetches the content of the selected file when component mounts or dependencies change.

methods.name: ask
methods.description: Helper function that prompts the user for input with a label and default value.

methods.name: doSave
methods.description: Saves the current content to the selected file.

methods.name: doRename
methods.description: Renames the selected file or directory.

methods.name: doMove
methods.description: Moves the selected file or directory to a new path.

methods.name: doCopy
methods.description: Copies the selected file or directory to a new path.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Deletes the selected file or directory.
